newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Broadcasting up on Fuji TV listing reports.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Broadcasting up on Fuji TV listing reports.

text.p: Shares of Nippon Broadcasting System Inc rose in Tuesday afternoon trade, encouraged by media reports that Fuji Television Network Inc was hoping to go public, brokers said.
Nippon Broadcasting owns a 45.6 percent stake in Fuji.
As of 0448 GMT, Nippon Broadcasting shares were up 200 yen at 10,300.

"Nippon Broadcasting shares were in negative territory until reports of Fuji TV's plans to apply for listing appeared, which started attracting speculative buying," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
Jiji news agency reported a Fuji Television executive as saying the firm would like to list its shares within the year.
